Name: Versatile Flags Mod (Content Patcher)
Author: cozywithhelen
TagLine: Just some very basic flags to hang on your wall. Goes with any aesthetic.
Description:
Adds three cute, totally versatile wall-hangable flags to decorate your farmhouse.

Requirements:
Stardew Valley 1.6+
SMAPI
Content Patcher

Installation:
Install SMAPI and Content Patcher if you haven't already
Drop the VersatileFlags folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory
Launch the game

Getting the Flags In-Game:
Buy the furniture catalogue from Robin's shop, then select the flags from the catalogue menu. Alternatively, use an item spawner mod :)

Compatibility:
Should be compatible with any other mods. No vanilla assets are replaced.
